## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the empty-criteria regression before merge because it marks a requirement as proven without supporting criteria. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request modernizes handler annotations and logging, replaces the sorting lambda with `itemgetter`, and changes requirement proof to compare a sum with the criterion count.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return false for an empty criteria list — Passing `[]` now returns `True` instead of the previous `False`. Removing `bool(criteria)` lets the empty sum equal the zero criterion count after the warning. — Release-review callers can treat a requirement with no supporting criteria as satisfied, bypassing the previous minimum-evidence check. — Fix: Restore the nonempty guard and extend `test_requirement_proof` with the empty-list case.
